{{Quote|The Rebels have been placing piles of presents in Wayfar, Doaba Guerfel and Dearic, claiming they are 'gifts' for the poor. We're however sure that most of them are full of propaganda and maybe even weapons, so we need you to destroy them!|Sstrigge to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Sstrigge''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] trader. When the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tried to organize [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] festivities in the cities of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], and [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Sstrigge helped the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] disrupt their efforts. He rewarded citizens loyal to the Empire with various rewards for sabotaging the celebrations.

He wore parts of [[Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sstrigge was a [[Wikipedia:non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day live event from [[December 16]], [[2008]] to [[January 12]], [[2009]] he could be found in Dearic, Wayfar, and Doaba Guerfel.

For stomping and destroying Life Day presents lying in the streets of the cities, players of the Imperial faction were awarded special Imperial Propaganda Tokens that could be redeemed for decorative items by talking to Sstrigge. Rebel-aligned players had to talk to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Oolovv]] instead.
